equations: Normalize all A(C)+sum_g logsumexp(B_g(E|C)) and each complete B_g before pruning; parent/extension pairs are not normalized separately per parent after evidence.

input_contract.priors: represented parent priors sum to one, identical across their extensions
input_contract.transitions: each parent has normalized transitions and exactly one explicit unknown extension
input_contract.identity: bounded parent/extension slots, duplicates rejected; caller owns actual compatible path state
input_contract.missing: all conditional potentials suppressed on a fully missing interval; transitions remain active
input_contract.zero_groups: Zero through eight groups, same count under each shared pair. Empty local product is one: shared-only normalization. Empty shared inventory or an existing group with an empty local candidate list remains invalid.

numerics: Center potentials before adding prior/transition logs; retain local partition shift and residual separately before shared evidence. Zero-prior/transition rows cannot affect centering. Invalid relative normalization rejects without replacing the last published numeric posterior.
unknown: Explicit unknown and pruned mass remain separate. Retained resolved weights are not renormalized. Shared unknown carries no retained local identities. Unused group slots are cleared on inventory shrink.
candidate_connection: Multiply retained shared and selected-group local masses, match supported candidate inputs by both parent/extension pairs, reject orphan or duplicate identities, and pass the bounded result into the existing consequence kernel. Missing projections increase unknown; they do not recover original unknown.
head_coverage: consequence and joint preview now take a three-head issue-coverage array; each head backs off independently after hypothetical path mixing. No shifted-window coverage is substituted.

later_identity_loss.interpretation: synthetic later cue distinguishes a discarded identity; mass conservation on the earlier step does not preserve later interpretive information
